lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular arrangement of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately four horizontal tiers with variable spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular clusters, forming a visible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, dark-reddish pixel clusters along the mid-flank region; a non-biological white graphical arrow points to a specific area of the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A concentration of small, reddish-brown marks is visible on the upper-mid flank, posterior to the cranial region.
